title: Goodbye to Taipei Main Station’s Famous Floor

content.en: Taiwan has some busy train stations. But the busiest one is Taipei Main Station. Every day, hundreds of thousands of people use it!
content.tw: 台灣有好幾個繁忙的車站，其中又以台北車站進出的旅客最多。

content.en: The station has a famous floor. Many people love it. It has big black and white squares. It has ten big emojis! They show smiling and laughing faces. The word "smile" is on the floor too. It is in ten languages! People walk on this floor. They sit on it. They meet friends there. They take photos on it! They take photos OF it!
content.tw: 台北車站的地板是黑白格子圖案，有很大的表情符號，也有用不同語言表達「微笑」這個詞！朋友們約在這裡見面，甚至跟地板合照！

content.en: But now the station is getting many changes. One big change is the floor. There will be no more black and white squares or emojis. Some people feel a little sad about this change. Some are saying goodbye to the black and white floor.
content.tw: 車站即將大改造，棋盤格子地板會被拆掉。有些人對這個改變感到很難過。

content.en: The new floor may have smaller gray squares and light gray rectangles. This is a big change, but people may like it. The new floor can make the station look brighter!
content.tw: 新地板則由小的灰色方格和淺灰色長方形組成，希望能讓車站空間看起來更明亮！

content.en: The station is getting new things too. A giant screen will show pictures of Taiwan. It might show sports games with Taiwanese players too. People can cheer for their favorite players! And the station will get new elevators and a big clock.
content.tw: 車站還會新增一個超大的螢幕，讓人們可以一起看運動賽事，為台灣選手加油。另外，車站中央還要放個大時鐘，做為新的地標。

content.en: The changes will be done in two years and eight months. Taipei Main Station will be better for everyone!
content.tw: 這些工程將會在兩年八個月內完工。台北車站將會變得更好！

vocabulary.preface: 台北車站即將改頭換面，讓它更方便，但是舊的東西也隨之而去。

content.text:
1. change 改變。
Do you like change? 你喜歡改變嗎?
You mean having sandwiches today and pizza tomorrow? 你是說今天吃三明治明天吃披薩?
No. I mean real change.不,我是說真正的改變。

2. say goodbye 道別。
I don’t know. I sure like old friends.不知。我喜歡老朋友。
Oh, so you don’t like saying goodbye. 所以你不喜歡道別。

3. friend 朋友。
Of course not, do you? 當然不，你喜歡嗎?
Well, I like making new friends. 我喜歡交新朋友。

4. black 黑色，white 白色。
It’s not a black-and-white thing. 那又不是非黑即白的事情。You can have both old and new friends. 你可以有老朋友和新朋友。
True. 確實是。

vocabulary.postscript: 來讀今天的單字。change改變 say goodbye道別 friend朋友 black黑色 white白色

title: An Inside Night Market Open During the Day

content.en: Do you like night markets? They are loud. They have a lot of people. But they also have a lot of tasty food. You can have popcorn chicken, egg cake, and much more! There is food everywhere you go at night markets!

Taoyuan Airport is the biggest airport in Taiwan. It is loud too. It also has a lot of people. About seventy thousand people get on planes here every day! Many of them are from other countries. They love visiting Taiwan. And they love Taiwan's night markets!
Now there is a night market inside this airport. It is open during the day too. People can go to it and then get on their plane! It makes waiting at the airport fun!
But wait…how can a night market be inside an airport? Night markets are outside. And they are open at night. They are not open during the day!

Well, this night market is not a real one. But people have a good time there! They take pictures with a very big chicken leg, grilled corn, or bubble tea. But they cannot eat or drink them. These are also not real! But people CAN eat a real egg cake... for free!

This night market has games too. One game has pictures of some night market foods. It shows people where they can buy these foods in the airport. People can also make art about night markets... for free!
This fun night market ends on the eighteenth. It is making people leave Taiwan with a big smile!
content.tw: 這個有趣的夜市將在十八號結束。它讓離開台灣的人們都帶著燦爛的笑容！

vocabulary.preface: 夜市熱鬧非凡，台灣人喜歡，也吸引眾多外國遊客。

content.text:
1. plane 飛機。
I can't believe you're getting on that plane and just leaving!
我不敢相信你就那樣上飛機走了!
Hey, I'm coming back next month! 我下個月就回來了!

2. at night 在晚上。
I know, but who would hang out with me at night? 我知道，但是誰來晚上陪我玩?
Come on, you can go to the night market by yourself. 少來，你可以自己去逛夜市啊。

3. fun 好玩的。
It’s no fun without you! 沒有妳不好玩!
You’re right. 你說得對。We eat too much and laugh too loud.我們吃太多，笑得太大聲。

4. eat 吃，drink 喝。
So will you come back next week? 所以你會下星期回來嗎? We can eat and drink together again.我們又可以一起吃吃喝喝。
Maybe.也許吧。

vocabulary.postscript: 今天的單字很簡單plane飛機 at night在晚上 fun好玩的 eat吃 drink喝

quiz.question: 1. Where is this night market?
2. What can people eat at this night market?
3. What can people make at this night market?

content.en: A pizza shop was having a busy day. But it was going to get busier! Someone called the shop. The person ordered 18 pizzas! That is a lot of pizzas!
content.tw: 美國一家忙碌的披薩店接到電話訂單，竟然點了18個大披薩！

content.en: The workers had so much to do then! So the pizza shop stopped taking orders. The workers worked and worked and worked. Forty minutes later, all of the pizzas were ready. But… nobody came to pick them up!
content.tw: 店員努力製作披薩，終於在40分鐘之後完成了訂單，卻沒有任何人來領。

content.en: A worker called the phone number for the order. The person on the phone said, "I did not order those pizzas!" Who ordered the pizzas? No one knows. It was a prank! A prank is a trick. Pranks can be fun. But some pranks are not nice. This one was not nice! Those 18 pizzas cost about 9,500 Taiwan dollars!
content.tw: 原來這是一場惡作劇，但是一點也不好玩，因為18個披薩要價約9500元台幣！

content.en: The pizzas had nowhere to go. Then the pizza shop owner had a great idea. He wanted to do something nice. His friend helped him.
content.tw: 這些披薩無處可去，於是披薩店老闆想到了一個好主意，他請朋友來幫忙。

content.en: His friend put the pizzas in his car. He drove to a hospital. He gave the pizzas to the doctors and nurses. The doctors and nurses were very happy! The pizzas were a big, delicious surprise!
content.tw: 朋友開車把披薩送到附近的醫院，分給醫生和護士們，讓他們非常開心。惡作劇變成了一個溫暖的驚喜。

content.en: The 18 pizzas were ordered for a prank. That was not nice. But the pizza shop made a bad prank into something kind. It shared with others!
content.tw: 這18個披薩是為了惡作劇而訂購的。那樣很不友善。但這家披薩店把一個糟糕的惡作劇變成了一件好事，與他人分享了！

vocabulary.preface: 雖然是惡作劇，結局卻讓人很開心。

content.text:
1. order 訂購。
I’m hungry, but I really don’t feel like cooking.我餓了，可是我不想做飯。Easy. Let’s order pizza. 很簡單，我們叫披薩。

2. cost 花費。
Great idea! I can even drive over and pick it up.好主意，我甚至可以開車去拿。
Good! Then it’ll cost less. 真好，那比較省錢。And can you get some drinks on your way back? 你在回來的路上買飲料好吧?
Sure.當然。

3. nice 很好。
It’s so nice of you! 你人真好!
Yeah, yeah. Just remember I’ll have the last slice. 好啦，只要記得我想要吃最後一片。

4. phone number 電話號碼。
Nobody makes pizza better than Pizza Heaven! 沒有人做得比披薩天堂好! Wow, I’ll keep their phone number. 哇，我會保留他們的電話號碼。

vocabulary.postscript: 你有訂過披薩嗎? order訂購 cost花費 nice很好 phone number電話號碼

b. He gave them to his workers.
c. He ate all of them.

title: These Cool Farmers Battle Each Other

content.en: In many places around the world, young people are farming. But they are not growing plants. They are aura farming. Aura is coolness. People say you can grow aura. That is why they call it "aura farming."
content.tw: 現在年輕人的新流行叫做 “aura farming”，就是透過耍酷來製造氣場。

content.en: An 11-year-old boy in Indonesia showed the world what aura is. He danced at the front of a fast boat. He did cool moves again and again.
content.tw: 印尼的11歲男孩為全世界示範如何耍酷。他站在一艘快速前進的船上，重複做動作。

content.en: Now there are aura battles. They are a new way to farm aura. In aura battles, no one fights. No one says bad things. No one touches the other person. So how do people battle? They dance. They do cool moves again and again.
content.tw: 現在還有耍酷大賽。比賽過程不互相對罵，也沒有肢體接觸，而是比誰的舞步更有魅力。

content.en: On a beach in Peru, young people are dressed like their favorite characters. Music plays. Two people battle. They dance. They do cool moves! Many people cheer! Who gets the loudest cheers? That is the winner!
content.tw: 在祕魯的海灘上，年輕人打扮成自己最愛的角色，跟著音樂跳舞。誰得到最多歡呼聲，誰就是贏家！

content.en: Many people watch aura battle videos online. Then some have aura battles. Now there are aura battles in Mexico, Brazil, Ecuador, Argentina, and Spain!
content.tw: 很多人也在線上觀看耍酷大賽。在巴西、墨西哥、厄瓜多、阿根廷和西班牙都有舉辦這個比賽！

content.en: Aura battles are fun. Young people make their own dances. They cheer for each other. They are cool!
content.tw: 耍酷大賽很好玩，年輕人可以展示自己的舞步，並且互相加油打氣！

content.en: How about you? Do you want to try an aura battle?
content.tw: 那你呢？你想試試耍酷大賽嗎？

vocabulary.preface: 最新流行的耍酷大賽，已經有許多國家參加。

content.text:
1. dance 跳舞。
Want to go to a movie tonight? 今晚要不要去看電影?
No. I have to dance tonight. 不去，我今晚要跳舞。
That’s your jazz dance lesson? 是你的爵士舞課嗎?
Yeah! 對。

2. move 動作。
Our teacher plays the music, 老師放音樂，and shows us some really cool moves. 做很酷的動作給我們看。And we try our best to follow.我們就努力跟上。

3. each other 互相。
Do you cheer for each other? 你們會不會互相加油?
No, we laugh at each other! 不會，我們互相嘲笑!

4. who 誰。
Who’s the best dancer in your class? 誰是你班上跳得最好的?
It’s certainly not me! 一定不是我!

vocabulary.postscript:
請跟我一起讀單字。
dance跳舞 move動作 each other互相 who誰

options: a. Showed the world what aura is
b. Went to an aura battle

quiz.question: 2. Where was the aura battle at the beach?
3. What do people do in aura battles?

title: This Temple in Taiwan Rains Money

content.en: What can fall on you like rain and snow? At a temple in Gukeng in Yunlin, money can!
content.tw: 除了下雪和下雨，還能下什麼呢？在雲林古坑鄉的一間宮廟，會下鈔票雨！

content.en: This temple makes money fall on people once a year. During Ghost Month, bags of red paper money are taken up to the roof. What money is red in Taiwan? Yes, the $100 bill is!
content.tw: 每年農曆七月，這座宮廟的工作人員都會從屋頂撒下紅色的百元鈔票。

content.en: This year, the temple had $80,000 to throw. Wow! How many $100 bills is that? Yes, that is 800 bills!
content.tw: 今年，他們準備了八萬元的百元鈔票，總共800張鈔票！

content.en: The people up on the roof opened the bags. The people below were ready to catch some bills! Many held their hands high. Some stayed close to the ground. Maybe some bills would fall there!
content.tw: 人們在宮廟屋簷下，雙手高舉或者蹲下來等著，期待鈔票落到面前。

content.en: The people on the roof threw the 800 bills! It rained money! The people below jumped and yelled. They were excited! They tried their best to catch the bills. Some got $1,000 or more! Then in one minute, all the money was gone!
content.tw: 鈔票雨開始了! 大家又叫又跳，興奮地開搶！不到一分鐘所有的錢都搶光了。

content.en: Why does the temple throw money? A woman from Vietnam started this temple. Temples in Vietnam have thrown money for hundreds of years. It is a way to share good luck!
content.tw: 一位越南女性來台灣之後建了這座宮廟，而撒鈔票是越南傳統習俗。幾百年來，當地宮廟都會這麼做來分享福氣。

content.en: More people from Vietnam are living in Taiwan. Something that has been done in Vietnam for a long time is now done in Taiwan too. That is great!
content.tw: 有越來越多的越南人居住在台灣。在越南行之有年的習俗，現在台灣也看得到了。這真的很棒！

vocabulary.preface: 這座宮廟撒錢的習俗，是希望帶給大家好運。

content.text:
1. excited 興奮的。
Hey, your favorite K-pop group is coming! 你最喜歡的韓團要來!
When? 什麼時候?
In March next year. 明年三月。
I’m so excited!!! 我太興奮了!

2. jump 跳。
Will you stop jumping around? 你不要跳來跳去行不行?
Yeah, I should find out how to get the tickets.對，我應該來看看怎麼買票。

3. gone 走了，或是沒有了。
I bet the tickets will be gone in seconds! 我敢打賭那些票一定秒殺!
Then I have to be quick! 那我一定要動作快!

4. How many 有多少。
How many computers and cellphones do you have? 你有幾台電腦跟手機?
Five altogether! 一共五個!
Great! 好極了!

vocabulary.postscript:
你記住了今天的單字嗎?
excited興奮的 jump跳 gone走了，或是沒有了 how many有多少

2. How many $100 bills did the temple throw this year?
3. Where have temples thrown money for hundreds of years?

title: Did This Snake Start a Fire?

content.en: At a junior high school in the U.S., teachers teach. Kids learn. Everyone eats lunch. Later, everyone goes home. At the end of the day, no one is at the school.
content.tw: 在美國的一所國中，老師教書、孩子學習。大家吃午餐。隨後，每個人都回家了。在一天結束時，學校裡沒有人。

content.en: But one night, people were at the school. It was very noisy! The school was on fire! Oh no! Firefighters hurried to the school. They fought the fire. And they found... a snake? It was under a desk. It was almost two and a half meters long!
content.tw: 但有一晚，有人在學校。現場非常吵鬧！學校著火了！喔不！消防員趕往學校。他們撲滅了火災，然後發現了……一條蛇？就在課桌底下。這條蛇將近兩公尺半長！

content.en: This snake was a pet! It did not live under the desk. It lived in a tank in a classroom. But that night, it opened the tank for the first time! The firefighters say it broke a lamp then. That started the fire. And then the snake left the classroom.
content.tw: 這條蛇是一隻寵物！牠平時不住在課桌下。牠住在教室的水族缸裡。但那晚，牠第一次打開了水族缸！消防員說牠弄壞了一盞燈，進而引起火災。接著這條蛇離開了教室。

content.en: The firefighters think the snake started the fire! But wait! A teacher owns the snake. She does not think it started the fire. She says it opened the tank after the fire started. The classroom was very hot!
content.tw: 消防員認為是蛇引起了火災！但等等！一位老師擁有這條蛇。她不認為是蛇引起火災的。她說蛇是在火災發生後才打開水族缸的。當時教室非常熱！

content.en: Why was the snake living in the classroom? Well, the teacher teaches kids about living things. A tortoise was living in the classroom too.
content.tw: 為什麼蛇會住在教室裡呢？因為老師教導孩子們關於生物的知識。一隻烏龜也住在教室裡。

content.en: The teacher lost the tortoise and some books in the fire. But the school is safe now. It was cleaned after the fire. But the snake does not live there now. It lives at the teacher's home.
content.tw: 老師在火災中失去了一隻烏龜和一些書，但現在學校安全了。火災後學校進行了清理。但蛇現在不住在那裡，牠住在老師的家。

content.en: No one knows how the fire started. Maybe it was the snake. Maybe it was not. But everyone says the snake was not trying to start the fire!
content.tw: 沒有人知道火災是如何開始的。也許是那條蛇，也許不是。但大家都說那條蛇並非故意要放火！

vocabulary.preface: 一條蛇跑出了籠子，引起不小的誤會。

content.text:
1. classroom 教室。
My son brought home a classroom pet yesterday. 我兒子昨天把一隻教室寵物帶回家。
A stick insect.一隻竹節蟲。
That sounds interesting! 聽起來真有趣!

2. first time 第一次。
Yeah, and it’s his first time taking care of a living thing. 沒錯，這是他第一次照顧活的生物。
So is the bug staying with you? 所以竹節蟲待在你家?
Just for one week. 只待一個星期。

3. school 學校。
He’ll take it back to school afterwards. 之後他就要把蟲蟲送回學校。
That’s not a long time.時間不算長。

4. learn 學習。
No. But I think he can still learn a lot.不長，不過我想他還是會學到不少。
I'm just hoping we can find it when it's time to go! 我只希望到了該走的時候找得到那隻蟲。

vocabulary.postscript:
你有養過寵物嗎? 來讀單字。
classroom教室 first time第一次 school學校 learn學習

quiz.question: 1. Where was the fire?
2. Who thinks the snake started the fire?
3. Where does the snake live now?

content.en: Robots are everywhere. They build cars. They clean floors. They help doctors. And they can work all day and night! Some pizza shop owners want robots. They do not want them to sell pizza. They do not want them to deliver it. They want robots to make it!
content.tw: 機器人會做很多事，並且不會累。有些披薩店老闆也想雇用機器人來做披薩。

content.en: Making good pizzas is easy for pizza shop workers. But it is very hard for many robots. Sometimes they drop pizzas. Sometimes they put cheese in the wrong place. Many things can go wrong!
content.tw: 跟披薩店員工相比，做披薩對機器人來說困難許多。他們會把披薩弄掉地，放錯各種配料，什麼都有可能出錯！

content.en: Some robots can help make pizza. But other things can go wrong. A pizza shop owner bought two robots. They put tomato sauce and cheese on pizzas. They put pepperoni on them. And now the robots need to be fixed. But the robot company is closed! Nobody can fix them!
content.tw: 一家披薩店老闆買了兩個機器人來幫忙，需要維修的時候，卻發現機器人公司倒閉了！

content.en: This pizza shop owner is not giving up on robots. He is trying to make one! He says it will work like a 3D printer! Some robot companies are making pizza robots too. They want their robots to make pizza better than pizza shop workers or other robots.
content.tw: 但這位老闆不放棄，他想要自己設計披薩機器人。有些公司正在這麼做，希望他們創造的披薩機器人比真人還好用！

content.en: Will robots make good pizzas one day? Maybe they will. But for now, pizza shop workers make better pizzas than robots!
content.tw: 有一天機器人會做出美味的披薩嗎？或許吧。但就目前而言，披薩店員工做的披薩比機器人做的更好！

vocabulary.preface: 到目前為止，披薩機器人比不上店員親自做披薩。

content.text:
1) shop 商店。
I’m starving! Let’s order pizza.我餓死了，來點披薩吧。
That’s always a good idea! 那永遠是個好主意! There’s a new pizza shop down the street. 這條街過去新開了一家披薩店。

2) tomato 番茄。
Yeah, I saw it. 我有看到。Have you tried it? 你吃過了嗎?
I have. They make their own tomato sauce, 吃過，他們自製番茄醬，and they use a stone oven. 並且用石頭烤箱。

3) deliver 送貨。
Sounds like my kind of place! 聽起來就是我喜歡的店! Do they deliver? 他們有外送嗎?
I believe so.我相信有。

4) put 放。
Then what are we waiting for? 那我們還在等什麼?
What do you want them to put on the pizza? 你要他們在披薩上放什麼料? Stinky tofu…? Just kidding. 臭豆腐...? 開玩笑的。

vocabulary.postscript: 來一起讀單字。 shop商店 tomato番茄 deliver送貨 put放

quiz.question: 1. What do pizza shop owners want robots to do?
2. Why can nobody fix the two robots?
options: b. The robot company is closed.
c. The pizza shop owner has given up.

quiz.question: 3. What is the pizza shop owner doing now?

title: Lost Dog Goes to the Police

content.en: A woman in Kaohsiung has a small dog. The woman and her family often told him not to go outside. They worried that he would get lost. So the dog stayed inside.
content.tw: 高雄有位女子養了一隻小狗。因為怕小狗走丟，平時都讓牠待在家裡。

content.en: But one day, the dog saw an open door. He ran outside! And very soon, he was lost! Where was his home? He walked and walked. He got more and more lost. But he knew where to go for help!
content.tw: 有一天，小狗趁主人不在家，從開著的門溜了出去，結果很快就迷路了。但是牠知道要去哪裡找人幫忙。

content.en: The dog went to a police station! He slowly looked inside. The police officers looked down. They saw a small dog. The dog looked lost. The police officers let the dog stay at the police station. He was safe there. The police and the dog waited. Maybe someone would come and get him.
content.tw: 小狗去了警察局，警察就讓牠在那裏待著，或許主人會來接牠。

content.en: Back at home, the woman could not find her dog. She looked everywhere! He was missing! She was very worried.
content.tw: 女子回到家之後，發現小狗不見了，她擔心地四處尋找。

content.en: Then she thought of a place to look. It was the police station! She ran there. And... she saw her dog! He was sitting and waiting for her!
content.tw: 她想到可以去警察局試試看，發現小狗就坐在裡面！

content.en: The woman hugged her dog. She was very happy. She cried happy tears. Her dog was happy too! The woman was also surprised. How did her dog know to go to the police station?
content.tw: 她用力擁抱小狗，喜極而泣，同時也覺得非常驚訝，小狗怎麼會知道要來警察局呢？

content.en: In 30 minutes, this dog got lost and then found his way back to the woman!
content.tw: 在 30 分鐘內，這隻小狗迷路了，隨後又回到了女主人身邊！

vocabulary.preface: 聰明小狗找警察幫忙，真是找對了人!

content.text:
1. lost 迷途的。
Jane, are we lost? 我們迷路了嗎?
No way, I know exactly where we are! 沒有，我完全知道我們在哪兒。

2. police station 警察局。
Really? Where are we? 真的嗎，在哪兒?
Somewhere with many trees.在有很多樹的地方。
That’s very helpful. 還真有用。
Don’t worry. I saw a police station on our way up the mountain.別擔心，我們爬上山時我有看到警察局。

3. help 協助。
So you want to go back down to get help? 所以你要下去求助?
Yeah, and you just stay here and wait for me, okay? 對，你就留在這裡等我好嗎?

4. missing 失蹤。
Okay, I don’t want to go missing in these mountains. 好，我可不想在這個山區失蹤。

vocabulary.postscript: 你有沒有迷路過? lost迷途的 police station警察局 help協助 missing失蹤的

quiz.question: 1. Where do the woman and the dog live?
2. What did the dog do when he went to the police station?
3. How long did it take the dog to find his way to the woman?

title: The First Boat Trip In 300 Years

content.en: Indigenous people have lived in Taiwan for thousands of years. But not all of them stayed here! About four thousand years ago, some Tao people built boats. These boats were for long trips.
content.tw: 原住民在台灣生活了幾千年，但並不是一直定居在這裡。大約四千年前，達悟族人建造了可以航向遠方的船。

content.en: Some Tao people started new lives on other islands. They brought yams, taro, and animals like pigs to eat. Some brought things to trade.
content.tw: 他們帶著食物，以及可以交易的物品，到別的海島上生活。

content.en: The Tao people often went to an island in the Philippines. They looked at the stars to find the way there. The trip is about one hundred eighty kilometers!
content.tw: 他們通常前往菲律賓的小島，茫茫大海中只能依靠星星辨認方向。

content.en: The Tao people and this island's people were friends for a long time. But three hundred years ago, they became unfriendly! There were no more trips to the island!
content.tw: 達悟族人和小島居民往來了很長一段時間，但是後來中斷了。

content.en: But now the people are friends again. So three years ago, the Tao people planned a boat trip to the island. More than two hundred Tao people built a new boat. Its name means "golden friendship." It is 12 meters long. It does not have nails! That is how Tao boats were made long ago.
content.tw: 現在兩邊重建友誼，兩百多位達悟族人一起用古老的方法，建造了一艘黃金友誼號，沒有用任何鐵釘！

content.en: Then the boat was ready. Twenty people rowed it. They took turns with forty people on other boats. The waves were strong! Some were four meters tall!
content.tw: 20名族人划著這條船，跟另外一艘船上的40位族人輪流換手。經過24小時的努力，他們終於跟小島居民見面了！

content.en: But 24 hours later, the people on the island said hello to the Tao people. They called the Tao their "family from Lanyu"!
content.tw: 但24小時後，島上的居民跟達悟族人打招呼。他們稱呼達悟族人為「來自蘭嶼的家人」！

vocabulary.preface: 蘭嶼的達悟族人，跟菲律賓很有淵源。

content.text:
1. star 恆星。
I haven't camped out since high school. 我高中之後就沒有露營過了。
Yeah? You’ll love it. 是嗎? 你會喜歡的。
We can look at the stars and tell ghost stories…我們可以看星星，講鬼故事...

2. take turns 輪流。
Ghost stories? Maybe I’ll sleep in the car.鬼故事? 也許我會去睡在車上。
Or we can take turns keeping the fire going. 我們也可以輪流讓火不要熄滅。

3. animal 動物。
Why do we need a fire?! 為什麼需要火?
To keep the wild animals away. 讓野生動物不要靠近。
Animals?! 動物?!

4. stay 留下。
That’s it. I’m not staying here.夠了，我不要待在這裡了。
Where are you going? 你要去哪裡?
Home. You can send me pictures.回家。你可以寄照片給我。

vocabulary.postscript: 這些字常常用到。star恆星 take turns輪流 animal動物 stay留下

quiz.question: 1. When did Taiwan's Indigenous people build boats for long trips?
2. Who made the new boat?
3. What does the new boat's name mean?

title: Soccer School Kids Save a Team

content.en: Barcelona is one of the most famous soccer teams in the world. It is in Spain. Some of the world’s best soccer players have played on this team.
Barcelona has a soccer school. It looks for young soccer players around the world. It asks these kids to come to the school. This school is free!
Some kids go to this school from six years old! All of the kids there learn the best ways to play soccer. After playing for years, they are very, very good at soccer! Many want to play for Barcelona.
But for a long time, Barcelona had no room for these kids. It had famous players! They were older. They were not from the soccer school. And they cost a lot of money.
Then Barcelona spent too much money. Now it does not have money for famous players. It needs very good soccer players who are not famous.
Wait! The soccer school has very good players! These kids are not famous. They do not cost a lot of money. But can they play soccer as well as famous players? Yes, they can!
This year, the team has many players from the soccer school. They are all young. Some are teenagers! And they are exciting to watch!
Barcelona has played nine matches since August. And the team has won all nine matches! Wow! This is the first time the team has done this!
These young players are making sure Barcelona is still one of the best soccer teams in the world! The soccer school kids saved the team!
content.tw: 這些年輕球員確保了巴塞隆納仍是世界上最好的足球隊之一！足球學校的孩子們拯救了球隊！

vocabulary.preface: 巴塞隆納擁有舉世聞名的足球隊，也努力培養小足球員。

content.text:
1. around the world 全世界。
Guess what’s the most popular sport around the world. 猜猜看全世界最受歡迎的運動項目是哪個?
Hmmm, running? 是跑步嗎?
Nope. 不對。
Then…Baseball? 那麼是棒球?
Wrong again. It’s soccer! 又錯啦，是足球!

2. young 年輕的。
Oh, I should have known that! 我應該猜到的! I played soccer when I was young, you know. 我小時候會踢足球。

3. older 比較年長的。
Well, now that you’re older, you should be a better player! 你現在大多了，應該踢得更好了。
I doubt that very much.我很懷疑。

4. famous 著名的。
Now I just watch soccer on TV. 我現在在電視上看足球。Those famous players are so handsome! 那些有名的足球員好帥!

vocabulary.postscript: 你喜歡哪一種運動? around the world全世界 young年輕的 older比較年長的 famous著名的

quiz.question: 1. Where is Barcelona's team?
2. Why did the team need players who were not famous?
options: a. It did not have money for famous players.
b. It did not have a school.
c. It did not have good players.

quiz.question: 3. Why is the team so good now?
options: a. It has lots of players.

content.en: In Uganda, a young girl helped in her family’s shop. She picked out tomatoes that were no good anymore. No one could eat them. She had to throw them away. Every morning, the girl did this. Lots of tomatoes went bad. It made her sad.
content.tw: 烏干達一個年輕女孩在自家的店裡幫忙，她每天都要丟掉好多爛番茄。

content.en: The girl became a woman. She went to university. She studied how to fix big problems. She kept thinking about the tomatoes. The woman had an idea. Cold air helps keep food fresh! She made a cold room. To stay cold, it uses solar power. That is energy from the sun!
content.tw: 女孩上大學後想到辦法，她決定蓋冷藏室來保存番茄。冷藏室的電力用太陽能。

content.en: She tried the cold room at her family's home. Before, tomatoes were good for a few days. Now, they are good for up to 21 days! The woman makes cold rooms for small farms now. They throw away less food. They have more food to sell!
content.tw: 她先在自己家裡測試冷藏室，後來也替別的小農場建造這個設備，不光是保存番茄，也有別的食物，大為減少浪費。

content.en: The woman is fixing more problems on small farms too. She uses solar power and AI. Solar power helps farms share water. AI tells them when to use it and how much to use. Farmers can grow more food!
content.tw: 另外，她也用人工智慧來幫助農場解決灌溉的問題，讓農夫收穫更多食物！

content.en: This woman made good things from bad tomatoes!
content.tw: 這位女性從爛番茄中創造了美好的事物！

vocabulary.preface: 這名女孩動腦筋解決番茄容易壞的問題。

content.text:
1. problem 問題。
I'm trying to grow tomatoes, 我正在試著種番茄，but I've got some problems. 但是遇到一些問題。
Oh no, what’s wrong? 糟糕，怎麼啦?
There are very few tomatoes on the plants. 番茄樹上果子非常少。

2. fix 處理。
It must be the weather. It’s just too hot. 一定是天氣的關係，太熱了。
So how can I fix it? 所以我該怎麼處理?
Try giving them some shade during the day. 你可以試試看白天時給它遮蔭。

3. not anymore 不再。
Good idea! 好主意! I thought I knew a lot about tomatoes. 我以為我很懂番茄。Not anymore.我不那麼想了。

4. grow 種植。
Well, I’m happy to help.我很樂意幫忙。
Next I’m planning to grow green beans. 我還想種四季豆。

vocabulary.postscript: 請跟我讀單字。problem問題 fix處理 not anymore不再 grow種植

quiz.question: 1. Why did the girl throw away tomatoes?
options: a. They were no good anymore.
c. They were not cold anymore.

quiz.question: 2. What did the woman study?
3. How does the cold room stay cold?

content.en: Long ago, some important people lived in a big castle. It is in Japan. It is made of wood and stone. It is VERY heavy.
content.tw: 在很久以前的日本，一座用木材和石材建造的城堡不只很重，還住了很多重要人物。

content.en: Some stones under the castle were broken. So the castle was moved eleven years ago. Workers fixed the stones. It took a looooong time. This summer, it was time to move the castle back. But how do you move something so big and heavy?
content.tw: 因為城堡底部受損，所以在十一年前被移到其他的地方修復。過了很久，工匠終於修復完成，但要怎麼將城堡移回原處呢？

content.en: People used a very old way. They used long ropes. Eighty people held the ropes. And everyone pulled at the same time! They shouted together! They pulled together! They were one big team. And little by little, the old castle moved!
content.tw: 人們決定採用古老的方法，八十個人同時拉動長長的繩索，城堡真的一點一點移動了。

content.en: Four thousand people took turns pulling. One was 82! Some people came from other countries to help pull. It was very hard. It was like pulling a mountain! It took FIVE DAYS to pull the castle five METERS. Machines will move it all the way back. But people are happy they got to pull the castle in this old, old way.
content.tw: 總共四千人輪流拉動城堡，也有其他國家的人參與。拉動城堡很困難，就像在拉整座山一樣，花了五天才前進五公尺，但人們依然覺得十分快樂。機器將會把它一路移回原位，但人們很高興能用這種古老的方式參與其中。

vocabulary.preface: 用古老的方式拖拉一座城堡，雖然辛苦但是也值得。

content.text:
1. rope 繩索。
You're coming to tomorrow's tug-of-war contest, right? 你明天會來拔河比賽吧?
To watch you guys pull on a rope? 去看你們拉一條繩子嗎? Yeah, why not? 會吧，為什麼不?

2. important 重要的。
And you'll yell "Pull! Pull!" for us, okay? 你會替我們大喊「用力拉」，對吧? Why is that so important?那有什麼重要? You'll pull hard anyway! 你們怎麼樣都會用力拉。

3. everyone 每個人。
Sure, but your cheering will help us win! 當然，但是你加油我們會贏。Everyone will be cheering for you! 每個人都會幫你們加油!

4. other 另一個。
But half of them will be cheering for the other team! 但是一半的人會替另一隊加油。
Okay, okay! I’ll cheer twice as loud! 好啦，我會叫得加倍大聲!

vocabulary.postscript: 來讀今天的單字。rope繩索 important重要的 everyone每個人 other另一個

options: a. Some wood on it was burned.
b. Some stones under it were broken.
c. Stones and wood were falling off of it.

quiz.question: 2. What did people use to pull the castle?
3. How far did people pull the castle in five days?

title: A New Way to Pay Less

content.en: What can you do to pay less for something? You can look at the prices in two or three stores. You can wait for a big sale. And at one place, you can dance to pay less!
content.tw: 怎麼樣用比較少的錢買到東西？可以貨比三家、等待大減價，或是用跳舞來打折！

content.en: A gas station in the U.S. started a fun way to save money. Customers dance for fifteen seconds. Some shake their bodies! Some move left to right! Some wave their arms!
content.tw: 美國有一間加油站，顧客跳舞15秒就可以打折。有些人晃動身體，有些人擺動手臂。

content.en: Do they like a dance they see online? They can do it! Do they like dancing to Kpop music? They can do it! Do they like to dance ballet? They can do it! Any dance is okay. Then they can pay twenty percent less for almost everything!
content.tw: 無論是流行舞蹈或是芭蕾都行。只要跳舞，加油站幾乎所有商品都能打八折。

content.en: Dancing makes customers happy. The gas station workers post videos of dancing customers online. One video got millions of views!
content.tw: 顧客跳得很開心，加油站員工也把錄下來的影片發到網路上，有的甚至得到幾百萬次點閱！

content.en: Why is the gas station doing this? Well, gas prices are high. But many people need to buy gas. The gas station wants to help them. Dancing makes their wallets and hearts happier!
content.tw: 現在汽油很貴，但開車必須有汽油，所以加油站希望提供幫助，跳舞打折讓他們又省錢又快樂！

content.en: Would you dance to pay less for something? Yes? Well, show us!
content.tw: 你會為了少付點錢而跳舞嗎？會嗎？跳給我們看吧！

vocabulary.preface: 跳舞十五秒，汽油錢就可以打八折，這是不是很吸引人?

content.text:
1. shake 搖晃。
I learned a new dance yesterday. 我昨天學了一支新舞。Want me to show you? 要我跳給你看嗎？
Sure. 當然。
First, shake your body like this…and then kick.你先這樣搖晃身體，然後踢。

2. left 左邊，right 右邊。
Hey, that looks easy! 看起來很簡單。I just go from left to right and then back.我就這樣從左到右再回來。
Yeah, you’re almost there! 你幾乎做對了！

3. need 需要。
This is a fun way to exercise! 這種方式做運動很好玩！
I know, right? And you don’t need to work hard.對，並且不用很辛苦。

4. arm 手臂。
Okay, what’s the next move? 好，下一步怎麼跳?
Put your arms up and wave! 舉起手臂來揮舞!

vocabulary.postscript: 你是愛跳舞的人嗎? 請來讀單字。shake搖晃 left左邊 right右邊 need需要 arm手臂

quiz.question: 1. Where is the gas station?
2. How long do customers have to dance?
3. How much less do customers pay when they dance?

content.en: Taiwan has robots in some restaurants. But it does not have them on sidewalks. In five cities in the U.S., new robots are moving on sidewalks.
content.tw: 台灣有些餐廳會僱用機器人，而在美國五座城市，新式的機器人卻出現在人行道上。

content.en: These robots are about 90 centimeters tall. They move about as fast as a person walks. They are white. They wear a yellow safety vest so cars can see them. And they are cute! Kids love taking pictures with them.
content.tw: 這些機器人大約 90 公分高，走路的速度跟行人差不多。他們的身體白色，穿著黃色的安全背心，看起來非常可愛，小孩子超愛跟它們合照。

content.en: But these robots have a big job. They look at sidewalks very carefully. They look for cracks and bumps. They look at how flat and wide the sidewalks are.
content.tw: 這些機器人任務重大，不但要仔細檢查人行道上有沒有裂縫或是凸起，也要看看它的寬度和平坦的程度。

content.en: In one day, one robot can look at almost 10 kilometers of sidewalks! The robots send all they find to city workers. Then the workers fix the broken sidewalks.
content.tw: 每個機器人一天可以檢查將近10公里的人行道！如果發現損壞，機器人會傳送通知給維修人員。

content.en: Fixing these sidewalks is important. Sidewalks help keep people safe from cars. Broken sidewalks can hurt people. They can make people fall. They can also make people walk on streets. That is not safe at all!
content.tw: 人行道維護非常重要，因為受損的人行道可能會絆倒行人，或者讓行人被迫走到馬路上，非常危險。

content.en: There are many sidewalks that need to be fixed here. Ouch! We need these robots!
content.tw: 這裡有很多需要修理的人行道。哎呦！我們需要這些機器人！

vocabulary.preface: 美國大城市人行道上的機器人，主要功能是檢查路面是否平整好走。

content.text: 1. cute 可愛的。Look! A robot is delivering our food! 你看，機器人在送我們的餐點。Uh...I'm not sure I like that. 我不確定是不是喜歡。And it's wearing a cute apron! 它還穿著可愛的圍裙!
2. take a picture 照相。Here it comes! 來了! Want to take a picture with it? 想跟它合照一張嗎? Absolutely not! 絕對不要!
3. hurt 傷害。You don’t like robots, do you? 你不喜歡機器人對吧? No, I don’t. 是不喜歡。I often think they may hurt people.我常常覺得它們可能會傷害人類。
4. street 街道。What if you see one on the street? 要是你在街上看到機器人呢? I will run away as fast as I can. 我會儘快跑開。

vocabulary.postscript: 今天的單字還記得嗎？ cute可愛的 take a picture拍照 hurt傷害 street街道

quiz.question: 1. How many cities are these robots in?
2. Why do the robots wear yellow safety vests?
options: a. So kids will take pictures of them
b. So cars can see them
c. So they can stay warm in winter

quiz.question: 3. Who fixes the broken sidewalks?

content.en: In September, it rained... and rained... and rained. It was very wet in Kaohsiung!
content.tw: 九月的高雄下雨下個不停，整個城市都變得非常潮濕！

content.en: When it rains so much, the air in homes can get wet. That makes things in homes wet. When things stay wet, mold can grow.
content.tw: 一旦房屋裡的空氣和物品充滿濕氣，就可能造成發霉。

content.en: Mold looks fuzzy. It can be white or green or black. It does not smell good!
content.tw: 黴菌毛絨絨的，顏色有綠有白 or 黑色，而且有霉味！

content.en: In Kaohsiung, people had moldy shoes. They had moldy bags and jackets! Many people went to a shop. This shop knows how to clean mold. The people brought lots of moldy shoes, bags, and jackets.
content.tw: 在高雄，很多人帶著發霉的鞋子、包包和夾克到一家商店，希望店家能幫忙清除黴菌。

content.en: Workers at the shop were very, very busy. They needed to clean everything fast. Mold grows and grows! It gets worse fast.
content.tw: 店裡的員工超級忙碌，因為黴菌不停地長，他們需要盡快把黴菌清掉。

content.en: Mold is not good for health. The workers wore masks and gloves to clean things safely. They washed the moldy things by hand. They made sure all the mold was gone!
content.tw: 黴菌對身體有害，所以員工都會戴著口罩和手套工作，並且確保黴菌完全清掉。

content.en: So how can you keep mold away? Do not leave wet shoes or bags in a closed box. Fresh air helps keep mold away.
content.tw: 讓濕掉的鞋子和包包接觸新鮮空氣，就能減少發霉。

content.en: The next time it rains a lot, try to keep your things dry! Or you might find mold on your things too...
content.tw: 下次下大雨時，試著保持物品乾燥！否則你可能也會發現你的東西發霉了...

vocabulary.preface: 發霉的衣物，可以交給專業的店家清除。

content.text:
1. jacket 夾克。
Yuck! There’s mold on my jacket! 我的夾克上面長黴了!
Eww, that’s gross! 有夠噁心! You need to take it out and air it. 你得把它拿到外面讓它透氣。

2. wet 潮濕的。
Why is there mold? 為什麼會發霉?
It’s this wet weather. 都是這個濕答答的天氣。You’d better check your shoes.你最好檢查一下鞋子。

3. rain 下雨。
Oh no! Mold is on my favorite shoes, too! 糟了，我最喜歡的鞋子也有黴!
Did you wear them in the rain? 你下雨時穿著它嗎?
Yeah, but that was weeks ago! 對，可是那好幾個星期之前了!

4. dry 乾的。
Well, if you didn’t keep them dry, 要是沒有保持乾燥，mold could start to grow. 就可能開始發霉。

vocabulary.postscript: 這些單字你記住了嗎? jacket夾克 wet潮濕的 rain下雨 dry乾的

content.en: People spend A LOT of time scrolling on their phones. They scroll up... and down. They look at pictures. They scroll left... and right. They watch short videos. Scrolling can be fun. But too much scrolling can also make people feel sad.
content.tw: 人們花很多時間滑手機，看照片或是短影音，但是太投入也可能影響心情。

content.en: Singapore wants its people to spend less time scrolling. It wants them to read more books. So now it has a fun new plan!
content.tw: 新加坡希望人民少滑手機、多看書，於是推出了一個有趣的計畫。

content.en: People read a book for fifteen minutes. Then they get points. They can get points once a day. When they have many points, they can get a little money!
content.tw: 只要閱讀 15 分鐘，就能獲得點數，每天可以領一次。累積很多點數後，就能換錢。

content.en: Reading for fifteen minutes is easy. People can read on the bus. They can read before bed! Poof! Fifteen minutes goes by fast!
content.tw: 閱讀15 分鐘很容易，在公車上或是睡前都可以做，15 分鐘一下子就到了。

content.en: Reading a little every day can make it a habit. A habit is something people do again and again. They do it almost without thinking. Reading books is a good habit!
content.tw: 每天少量閱讀會養成習慣，而看書是個好習慣！

content.en: Maybe more people in Singapore will read books now. Maybe they will spend less time scrolling. And maybe some people will feel happier!
content.tw: 或許會有更多新加坡人開始讀書，減少滑手機的時間。有些人也可能因此變得更快樂！

content.en: Do you want to try reading for fifteen minutes a day too? Go for it!
content.tw: 你也想嘗試每天讀書 15 分鐘嗎？放手去做吧！

vocabulary.preface: 新加坡鼓勵大家多看書，可以換成錢呢!

content.text:
1. plan 計畫。
I’ve got a new plan! 我有一個新計畫! I’m going to get points for walking! 我要用走路來拿點數。
Okay. But what are the points for? 好，但是點數有什麼用?
For prizes like smart watches! 可以拿獎品，比如說智慧手錶!

2. less 較少的。
That sounds nice! 聽起來真不錯!
And, it’ll get me to spend less time watching TV! 而且會讓我少看一點電視。

3. point 點數。
Now that sounds great! 聽起來更棒! So how many points do you need? 那你需要幾點?
At least one thousand.至少一千點。

4. minute 分鐘。
How much walking is that? 那要走多少路?
Just 30 minutes a day for one month. 只要一天三十分鐘，走一個月。
Hmm…Can you get points for walking to the fridge? 走到冰箱可以得到點數嗎?

vocabulary.postscript: 你有參加過這一類的計畫嗎? plan計畫 less較少的 point點數 minute分鐘

content.en: There is a new big park in Taiwan! It's in a very big old building in Kaohsiung! Yes, it is indoors! And it is the size of two soccer fields. Wow!
content.tw: 高雄一棟老建築裡，一座室內遊樂園最近開幕了，占地有兩個足球場那麼大！

content.en: The park has many fun things to do! You can climb on all kinds of walls. You can climb high on a very big rope net! You can run and roll on big gray blocks. You can jump on a big white cloud. You can ride your bike on a track with big bumps and curves!
content.tw: 這裡好玩的東西可多了！你可以爬牆攀岩，在障礙方塊上跑，在雲朵彈跳床上跳，還可以在不平整的坡道騎腳踏車！

content.en: The park has train cars too. Why? A long time ago, trains were fixed in this building. People said it was a train hospital! You can learn all about it at the park.
content.tw: 園區裡有火車廂，因為很久以前，火車都在這裡維修，園區裡也有這段歷史的介紹。

content.en: The building is open to the outdoors. That makes the air in the park nice and fresh. And when Kaohsiung is hot, you can have fun cooling down here. The park sprays mist! Whoooo! You can also cool down in the water play area!
content.tw: 園區是半開放式，讓空氣保持清新。大熱天的時候可以來這裡乘涼，或到親水區玩耍。

content.en: The park is for people of all ages. And moms and dads with baby strollers and people in wheelchairs can move easily here. And this park is free!
content.tw: 園區不限年齡，也完全免費！推娃娃車的爸媽和坐輪椅的人都能到處移動。

content.en: So come and take a look... and play!
content.tw: 所以來這裡看看...一起玩吧！

vocabulary.preface: 高雄最大的親子樂園，有許多種遊樂設施。

content.text:
1. children 兒童。
What should we do this weekend? 我們這周末做什麼好? I need to relax. 我需要放鬆。
Let's go to the children’s amusement park! 我們去兒童樂園吧!

2. climb 攀爬。
What? I’m not a kid any more. 什麼? 我已經不是小孩了。
Come on, we can ride bikes and do rock climbing! 去啦，我們可以騎車或是攀岩! It'll be fun!
會很好玩的!

3. ride 騎車。
I can’t climb rocks.我不會攀岩。I’ll fall right off! 會摔下來! And riding a bike isn’t
my thing.我也不喜歡騎車。

4. play 玩耍。
You’re no fun! 你真無趣! Don't you ever play? 你都不玩耍嗎?
I do! I play cards every night! 我會啊，我每天晚上都玩牌。

vocabulary.postscript: 你喜歡兒童樂園嗎? children兒童 climb攀爬 ride騎車 play玩耍

content.en: We do not know a lot about the ocean and its plants and animals. To learn more, scientists in the U.S. made a robot that can fly! It can also dive into water and swim. All of these are very hard for robots to do.
content.tw: 為了多多了解海洋和海洋生物，美國的科學家造了一個能飛行，潛水和游泳的機器人。

content.en: The scientists studied some birds first. These birds fly. But they can also dive deep into water and swim. The scientists studied how the birds move their wings in the air and in water.
content.tw: 為了造這個機器人，科學家先研究會飛也會潛水的鳥，看牠們的翅膀如何在空氣和水中運作。

content.en: Then the scientists made the robot. It weighs 250 grams. They tried many wing sizes. In the end, they made each wing 44 centimeters wide. The wings are made of strong, light cloth.
content.tw: 做出來的機器人只有250公克重，每個翅膀寬44公分，使用強韌但輕薄的布料。

content.en: The wings move fast in the air. In the water, they help the robot swim like a fish. Then they push the robot off the water and into the air!
content.tw: 翅膀在空中會快速拍動，在水裡則幫助機器人游泳，並推動機器人衝破水面，飛到空中。

content.en: The scientists tested the robot in a big tank of water and in a lake. It can fly! It can dive! It can swim!
content.tw: 科學家在水缸和湖中進行測試，成功讓機器人在空中飛、水裡游。這個機器人在了解海洋生物方面，也許真的可以幫上忙！

content.en: Maybe this robot can study ocean plants and animals one day. Then we can understand the ocean more!
content.tw: 也許有一天這個機器人可以研究海洋動植物。那我們就能對海洋有更多的了解！

vocabulary.preface: 科學家寄望有多種本領的機器人，能帶我們多認識海洋動植物。

content.text:
1. dive 潛水。
I'm thinking of taking diving lessons. 我在想去上潛水課。
Diving? You can hardly swim! 潛水? 你連游泳都不大會耶!
Of course I can! 我當然會!

2. swim 游泳。
Didn’t you see me in the pool yesterday? 你昨天不是看到我在游泳池裡?
You were floating, not swimming. 你是在漂浮，不是游泳。

3. fly 飛行。
Diving in the ocean would be much more exciting! 在海裡潛水會刺激得多!
I have a better idea! 我有個更好的主意。How about learning to fly first? 你先學飛行如何?

4. in the air 在空中。
You mean like flying an airplane? 你是說開飛機嗎? Great idea! 真棒的主意!
Right? You’ll be in the air instead of underwater! 是不是? 你會在空中而不是在水底!

vocabulary.postscript: 今天學會三個動詞。dive潛水 swim游泳 fly飛行 in the air在空中
